name: SmartSight
summary: Smart glasses built around a Raspberry Pi camera. Inspect how a capture moves from the wearable to a cloud archive.
steps: A browser on the local network triggers the camera through Flask. Keeping controls in the browser lets a phone operate the device.
Still images can upload directly. Video passes through FFmpeg so the result plays on phones and desktops.
Rclone transfers the file to OneDrive. The documented cleanup step waits for a successful upload before reclaiming local space.

name: Prakriti AI
summary: A biodiversity research assistant that retrieves environmental evidence and traces the sources behind an answer.
steps: Qdrant combines lexical and semantic retrieval. Exact species names and questions phrased in ordinary language can both contribute candidates.
Reciprocal rank fusion combines result rankings before generation. This introduces a retrieval stage that can be inspected separately.
The documented citation gate checks the response after generation. Source coverage still depends on the indexed collection.

name: KrishiSetu
summary: A multilingual platform for exploring government schemes, interpreting documents and investigating crop problems.
steps: Regional-language navigation gives farmers a familiar entry point to the platform.
Scheme eligibility, document processing and crop diagnostics each collect different inputs.
The crop workflow accepts a leaf photograph for analysis. Image quality affects what the system can infer.
